name: Rajesh Exports Ltd
tagline: Once India's largest gold-jewellery exporter and owner of Valcambi (Swiss refiner) -- now under a SEBI interim order alleging ~Rs 15 lakh crore of unverifiable revenue; an EXCLUDE red flag
business_overview: Rajesh Exports is a Bengaluru-based gold-jewellery manufacturer and exporter that, through overseas subsidiaries (notably Valcambi in Switzerland), reported one of the largest toplines of any Indian listed company. On 3 June 2026 SEBI passed a 109-page interim order alleging that ~Rs 15.15 lakh crore of the Rs 15.45 lakh crore revenue booked FY21-FY25 could not be independently verified, that 97-99% of revenue sat in overseas subsidiaries, and that forensic auditor BDO India was denied access to the ERP system and books.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 2,450 Cr (collapsed from a peak far above this)
~Rs 7.79 lakh cr FY26 headline -- the subject of the SEBI dispute
~1.2% -- negligible despite the enormous reported topline
Fell to ~Rs 104 on BSE, ~54% below the 52-week high of ~Rs 239 (Dec 2025)
fundamentals_narrative: The headline scale (fourth-largest Indian company by reported sales) has never translated into returns -- ROE ~1% -- which is itself a tell. The June 2026 SEBI interim order is an active regulatory action alleging revenue misrepresentation on an extraordinary scale, with the forensic auditor locked out of the accounting systems. Until that is resolved the reported financials cannot be relied upon.
